history.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. One complete landscape 4:3 watercolor painting for The Burnt Book; canvas exactly 4:3, not square.
Refined Indian watercolour with restrained gouache on warm ivory paper, organic detail, quiet ochre, sage, dusty terracotta and muted indigo, soft natural light. Warm and gentle; spirits are luminous and kind, never frightening. Phone-first composition: the main subject grouped in the centre, quiet margins. Text appears only where the brief asks for it, and then exactly as given.
Scene: Present day, evening, in the temple library: you (seen from behind) and Dādī at the low reading desk; a half-burnt palm leaf has begun to glow faintly gold; Śuka the parrot on your shoulder; brass lamps, shelves of palm-leaf bundles.
Characters present ONLY as the brief specifies: {"you":"Always seen from behind or at a distance, face never detailed, so every learner can be the hero: a young person in a simple ochre kurta with a cloth shoulder bag.","dadi":"A warm, sharp-eyed grandmother in her seventies, silver hair in a low bun, round spectacles, a cream cotton sari with a thin maroon border and a grey shawl; carries a cloth-bound notebook.","shuka":"A bright green rose-ringed parrot with a red beak and a faint pink and black neck ring, a little scruffy, very expressive eyes; usually on your shoulder or Dādī's."}
Place: {"granthalaya":"An old stone library beside a temple: carved wooden shelves of palm-leaf bundles, brass oil lamps, a low reading desk, an arched doorway onto the courtyard with the temple spire beyond."}
No extra people. The learner's face must remain invisible, viewed strictly from behind, simple ochre kurta and cloth shoulder bag.
Natural expressive figures, no gore or wound, warm reverence and gentle mystery. Central narrative grouping with quiet atmospheric margins, rich Indian watercolor detail. All palm leaves and books have BLANK surfaces or natural woodgrain only: no glyphs, written lines, letter shapes, readable or fake script. No typography, watermark, border, UI or symbols painted as text.
